summary: gentle-ai ships a deterministic, offline Go harness (bench/, its own go.mod, run in CI at .github/workflows/ci.yml:100-163) that measures the friction of its review lifecycle, such as human prompts, commands to completion and blocks, with no model calls and no timing, and commits one full run (bench/results.json: 64 journeys counted, 0 failed); a second results.json at the repo root records 0 counted and 1 failed journey. The README's 14-journey totals and its comparison with v2.1.2 (blocks 10 to 3 on the 5 comparable journeys) come from results-after.json and results-before.json, which are gitignored and not in the repo. The README's agent-performance table reports single (n=1) Gentle Shell runs with no data or harness in this repo; in it the data-migration run cost $0.555 against $0.403 before, and was accepted on the first round. The spec row and the comparison with Codex CLI link to gentle-shell PRs and an issue (#1718, #1723, #1794, #1713); the comparison reports that the large task took about three times longer (17.5–17.9 min vs 6.1 min).
